source: Department for Education, Schools, pupils and their characteristics, academic year 2025/26 (published 4 June 2026, last updated 14 July 2026). School level underlying data, aggregated to district administrative code (E07/E06/E08/E09).
caveat: Aggregated per district where the school sits, not where the pupil lives. Only state-funded schools are in scope; private schools excluded. Suppressed cells in the source are treated as zero (this affects very small schools).
